t: This is the site of the former David Beckham Academy, a football school founded by the England international David Beckham. It ran from 2005 to 2009, with one branch in London and another in Los Angeles. The academy pulled out of the London site when the lease ended in October 2009, and the California branch closed soon after. Beckham won 19 major trophies in his career, and he is the only English player to have won a league title in four different countries: England, France, Spain and the United States.
